# Someone here is lying 👀🚨 And in VR, you can’t hide 🫣                                                                                                                                                              

[media]

**Imposter VR**  is a **fast-paced social deduction party game** where real human behavior becomes the gameplay. Step into a shared space, look other players in the eyes, and try to survive the pressure 🕵️‍♂️🔥

[media]

**One player is the imposter.**

Everyone else must figure out who’s faking it — before the final vote 👉

There are no menus to hide behind. Your gestures, your silence, your distance, and your reactions can all expose you 😬

[media]

**WHAT MAKES IMPOSTER VR FUN**

• **Face-to-face multiplayer** with full social presence 👥

• **Physical deception** using movement, gestures, and eye contact 👀

• **Short 3–5 minute matches** built for quick sessions ⚡

• Loud accusations, tense debates, and **dramatic reveals**🎭

• **Easy to learn**, hard to lie 😈

• Designed for **friends, parties, and unforgettable moments** 🎉


Every round creates natural chaos — pointing fingers, nervous laughs, and sudden betrayals 💥

[media]

**No two matches ever play the same.**

Whether you’re jumping in with friends or playing with new people, Imposter VR delivers intense social pressure in minutes — perfect for parties and perfect for sharing 🎥📱


Trust breaks fast.
Tension builds quickly.
And when the vote begins… everyone is watching 🚨👀
